purpose: Immediate complete Arena correctness via a minimum-sufficient verifier portfolio, while retaining a path to a standalone Nucleus by monotonically shrinking fallback coverage.
routing_rule: Run Nucleus in-process. If and only if Nucleus returns ACCEPT, return ACCEPT immediately. Every non-accept Nucleus verdict is treated as incomplete positive authority and delegated to pinned MathGraph/Flash, whose accept/reject result is returned.
safety_condition: The positive fast path is qualified by a hard zero-false-accept gate over every current fixed reject test in the official downloadable corpus.
development_rule: Each newly qualified generic Nucleus semantic capability may only reduce fallback coverage. It must not change an already-correct composite outcome.
nonclaims: Not a fully independent Nucleus-only Lean kernel while fallback remains.
Prototype full-snapshot correctness does not itself benchmark the eight large accept workloads through the production router.
No claim that Nucleus REJECT is trusted by the composite; negative decisions are delegated.
